decisions.reason: As a standard bread line that was visible across its launch years, it fits the firm's core bakery business and is unlikely to be removed unless sales have clearly weakened.
A sweet pastry is somewhat more replaceable than staple breads, but if it is still selling in 2022 it is probably a useful part of the everyday assortment.
A crusty farmhouse bread matches traditional German bakery demand well and would typically be kept once established in the range.
An award-winning poppy seed Christmas stollen is a strong seasonal product for a German bakery or mill business, so it would usually be repeated rather than discontinued.
The premium Christmas stollen also has a gold award and supports seasonal premium sales, though premium variants are a bit more exposed to range simplification than core breads.
